scope: Eighteen path-composition, counterexample and interface statements for local chamber choices.
open_items: Define and justify chamber vertices and permitted crossings from the unchanged full Hug state, person and environment.
Derive a candidate local-route chooser from the actual memory, context and guard equations.
Prove that chooser finds compatible fresh units and coverage when appropriate, or correctly detects impossibility.
Specify and verify rechecking, stability or timed-transition rules under changing conditions.
Give a faithful finite encoding and account for every computation cost before making a complexity claim.
Establish any empirical interpretation or identification of an accepted graph certificate with full O.
